source.title: LLM 泛化：模型權重與 Harness

items.title: Resolve PR #77-only Worker Gateway files
acceptance: All eight PR #77-only files are folded or rejected with an explicit reason
Overlapping behavior is compared by execution rather than filename
Worker Gateway positive and mutation suites remain green
items.evidence_boundary: This stage proves residual-file disposition and current module behavior; it does not prove a live host.
items.human_boundary: Human owns semantic conflict decisions, merge, branch deletion and rollback.

items.title: Validate the merged LoopX foundation on current main
acceptance: Current-main reachability and exact subjects are pinned
Contract, Ledger, Gateway, Memory and Code Truth controls execute
Module, Context and proof projections agree at exact head
items.evidence_boundary: Reachability and deterministic controls do not prove composition selection, live providers or production admission.
items.human_boundary: Human owns any implementation repair merge and Stage-0 admission.

items.title: Implement Strategy Graph and scoped HITL
acceptance: Graph emits typed proposals only
Interrupt, resume, cancel and scoped-exception receipts bind exact ledger state
Stale checkpoint and duplicate-resume controls turn red
items.evidence_boundary: LangGraph checkpoints remain projections and never become task-state authority.
items.human_boundary: Human signs decisions and owns exception, merge and activation.

items.title: Implement redacted observability and signed HITL projection
acceptance: Redacted event envelopes rebuild deterministically from the ledger
Backend absence cannot alter a LoopX verdict
Signed HITL requests bind state revision and ledger head
items.evidence_boundary: Trace and UI projections observe state; they do not prove semantic correctness or commit state.
items.human_boundary: Human owns signer admission, backend activation, merge and retention policy.

items.title: Implement physical Runtime Fabric and local/cloud parity
acceptance: Workspace, process, network, secret and resource policies have observable enforcement ceilings
Cleanup, orphan recovery and residue controls execute
Local and cloud results remain separate exact-subject receipts
items.evidence_boundary: A local fixture or provider declaration cannot proxy physical cloud isolation.
items.human_boundary: Human owns runtime/provider activation, credentials, merge and rollback.

items.title: Implement Herdr/tmux-compatible Worker Fleet
acceptance: One Worker, branch, worktree and path lease are enforced
Queue dependencies, backpressure, cancellation and resource slots are observable
Orphan recovery is fail-closed and non-destructive
items.evidence_boundary: tmux session or Herdr exit status cannot establish task, Gate or release PASS.
items.human_boundary: Human owns collision resolution, destructive cleanup, adapter activation and merge.

items.title: Implement resource retention, disk budgets and GC
acceptance: Live, protected, blocked and expired resources are classified
Dry-run cleanup preserves ledger, Human decisions and blocked evidence
Residue and projection rebuild controls execute
items.evidence_boundary: GC receipts prove named resource cleanup only; they do not authorize deleting audit history.
items.human_boundary: Human owns destructive classes, retention policy, merge and rollback.

items.title: Implement a worktree-aware LSP pool
acceptance: Server, workspace, commit, config and freshness identities are bound
Cross-worktree, stale-index, OOM and cleanup controls turn red
A bounded CLI fallback has an explicit capability ceiling
items.evidence_boundary: LSP diagnostics are source evidence inputs, not runtime facts or Gate verdicts.
items.human_boundary: Human owns language-server admission, resource policy and merge.

items.title: Implement canonical Decision Memory runtime
acceptance: Human-admitted proposals become reducer-owned ledger events
Expiry, supersession, conflict, export and delete are executable
Replay is deterministic and projections rebuild from canonical events
items.evidence_boundary: Candidate compilation is not durable memory; projections remain lower authority than source and ledger.
items.human_boundary: Human owns admission, deletion/export authorization, merge and retention changes.

items.title: Admit Mem0 as an optional rebuildable projection
acceptance: Only admitted memory events enter the projection
Authority conflict, namespace leakage, delete/export and rebuild controls execute
Provider absence remains a typed non-PASS state
items.evidence_boundary: Mem0 retrieval is advisory and cannot become canonical memory or writeback authority.
items.human_boundary: Human owns provider mode, retention, writeback, activation and merge.

items.title: Implement immutable YouTube/PDF/Notes source ingest
acceptance: Raw artifacts, rights, dependency keys and locators are exact
Blocked media/transcript/OCR states remain explicit
Injection, duplicate-origin and destination-authorization controls turn red
items.evidence_boundary: Missing source bytes or rights cannot be replaced by generated summaries or estimated locators.
items.human_boundary: Human owns source rights, external destinations, admission and merge.

items.title: Build OpenWiki and vector/graph Notes projections
acceptance: Static and optional vector/graph projections bind the exact Notes Repo subject
Every returned unit retains provenance and locator
Freshness, UNKNOWN, delete and rebuild controls execute
items.evidence_boundary: OpenWiki, vector and graph results are rebuildable candidates, never source truth or absence proof.
items.human_boundary: Human owns provider selection, external embedding destinations, activation and merge.

items.title: Run live Serena and GrepAI canaries
acceptance: Executable, workspace, index, model and freshness identities are exact
Positive results require current-source readback
Stale, unsupported, outage and cleanup controls remain distinct
items.evidence_boundary: Symbol and semantic providers emit candidates only and cannot establish source absence or Gate PASS.
items.human_boundary: Human owns provider activation, external services and merge.

items.title: Admit a read-only Code-Graph-RAG adapter
acceptance: Read-only query surface and exact graph/index identity are enforced
Coverage, freshness, source provenance and delete/rebuild receipts exist
Write, delete and autonomous-edit tools stay outside normal Agent sessions
items.evidence_boundary: A graph edge is a candidate until current source or runtime evidence confirms it.
items.human_boundary: Human owns provider deployment, storage, privileged tools and merge.

items.title: Compile Notes Repo knowledge into scaffold candidates
acceptance: Evidence and assertions compile into typed cards, System Spec IR and CodeOp IR
Scaffold generation occurs only in a disposable workspace
Every generated contract, symbol and test maps back to source evidence
items.evidence_boundary: A generated scaffold is a candidate and cannot update source knowledge or release state automatically.
items.human_boundary: Human owns scaffold admission, architectural choices, merge and release.

items.title: Fold verified code and runtime evidence back into knowledge
acceptance: Diff, symbol, test and runtime deltas map to affected knowledge identities
UPDATE, SUPERSEDE, CONFLICT, UNKNOWN and NOOP remain distinct
Knowledge patches require evidence and Human admission
items.evidence_boundary: A code change does not automatically rewrite Notes, OpenWiki, cards or ADRs.
items.human_boundary: Human owns semantic reconciliation, card/ADR admission, merge and rollback.

items.title: Implement prompt-cache-stable Context Assembly
acceptance: Stable prefix and dynamic suffix are separately content-addressed
One Prompt IR renders all six host projections without normative drift
Budget overflow, cache comparability, secret and private-reasoning controls turn red
items.evidence_boundary: Cache observations are host/model/profile specific and cannot become universal performance claims.
items.human_boundary: Human owns normative prompt law, production projection promotion and merge.

items.title: Implement Skill and Prompt evolution with sealed holdout
acceptance: Current, candidate and no-skill baselines use identical execution contracts
Mutation/trap cases and sealed holdout stay separated
Hard-gate failure cannot be offset by LLM-as-a-Judge scoring
items.evidence_boundary: One host/model success cannot establish generalized capability or production promotion.
items.human_boundary: Human owns holdout access, candidate promotion, rollback and merge.

items.title: Implement local and exact-head GitHub Actions parity
acceptance: Repository-native and optional simulator lanes are machine-indexed
Exact-head GitHub runs are compared rather than inferred
Skipped, stale, action-required and billing states remain distinct
items.evidence_boundary: Local scripts or act cannot proxy GitHub-hosted runner permissions, services or exact-head status.
items.human_boundary: Human or trusted operator owns workflow dispatch, billing recovery, publication and merge.

items.title: Run the six-host live Worker matrix
acceptance: Codex, Claude, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi and Ante have independent exact-subject states
Every PASS includes execution, Gate and cleanup evidence
White-box, source-visible and gray-box trace ceilings remain explicit
items.evidence_boundary: Source visibility, package installation or another host's PASS cannot proxy a live host canary.
items.human_boundary: Human owns credentials, provider/model selection, host activation and merge.

items.title: Run paired Codex and Claude behavioral A/B
acceptance: Both hosts use the same immutable tasks, Context and Gate contract
Raw paired outcomes, failures and costs are retained
No host is selected from prose, a single case or incomparable subjects
items.evidence_boundary: Paired cases describe the pinned hosts and workloads only; they are not universal model rankings.
items.human_boundary: Human owns provider spend, model selection, promotion and merge.

items.title: Converge provider admission evaluation
acceptance: Every provider and deterministic control use the same immutable case contract
Complete participant-pair coverage and source readback are enforced
Fixture, live, unavailable and superiority states remain separate
items.evidence_boundary: Provider evaluation produces candidate recommendations; it cannot activate a provider or mark task state.
items.human_boundary: Human owns provider admission, comparison thresholds, activation and merge.

items.title: Implement the Harness Console
acceptance: Task graph, Gate evidence, diff, quota and provenance views are read-only projections
Signed actions bind exact revision and ledger head
Stale, duplicate, unsigned and projection-drift controls turn red
items.evidence_boundary: The Console prepares requests and cannot mutate state, mark Gates, merge, promote or rollback.
items.human_boundary: Human owns signer identity, action confirmation, production activation and merge.

items.title: Produce profile-scoped Harness benchmark evidence
acceptance: Raw failures, timeouts and OOM trials remain in versioned reports
Comparability binds workload, subject, environment and provider identities
Memory, TTFT, cache, cost and hardware claims remain profile-scoped
items.evidence_boundary: PDF or vendor numbers are source proposals until reproduced on exact profiles; five trials do not characterize a tail.
items.human_boundary: Human owns benchmark thresholds, claim promotion, spend and merge.

items.title: Admit the Git Town executable and bounded no-push runtime
acceptance: Executable, checksum, provenance, license and config are exact
Dry-run then live local no-push canaries and fail-closed controls execute
Local sync, GitHub publication, merge and release receipts remain separate
items.evidence_boundary: Git Town may synchronize admitted local branches; it cannot decide semantic conflicts, publication, merge or release.
items.human_boundary: Human owns conflict resolution, publication, merge/ship, promotion and rollback.

items.title: Converge modules, live acceptance, release and rollback
acceptance: Selected module, Context, proof and release sets are identical at exact head
Cold-start, Ledger, HITL, memory, Worker, provider, runtime, CI and projection canaries execute
Every exclusion remains named and Human Admit records release and rollback
items.evidence_boundary: Terminal green checks create release inputs; only convergence and Human Admit can produce an immutable release.
items.human_boundary: Human alone admits the release, promotion, rollback and any scoped exclusion.

human_owned_operations: Git Town continue, skip or undo
merge, ship, close or branch deletion
provider, model, runtime and credential activation
scoped exception and destructive cleanup admission
